name: Verify if a premium teacher can create recurring weekly activity with custom settings
description: Check if an existing teacher can create recurring weekly activity with custom settings for all classes
descriptionHtml: Check if an existing teacher can create recurring weekly activity with custom settings for all classes

testStage.description: Check if an existing teacher can create recurring weekly activity with custom settings for all classes

steps.name: $("By.tagName: h1") should have(text "Create your teacher account")
$("#app > div.app-body > div > div > div.page-card__left-half > div > form > div:nth-of-type(2) > div > input") should be(visible)
$("#app > div.app-body > div > div > div.page-card__left-half > div > form > div:nth-of-type(2) > div > input") get wrapped element()
$("By.xpath: //div[@class='v-input v-input--hide-details theme--light v-text-field v-text-field--single-line v-text-field--is-booted']//div[@class='v-text-field__slot']/input") should be(visible)

$("By.xpath: //div[@class='v-input v-input--hide-details theme--light v-text-field v-text-field--single-line v-text-field--is-booted']//div[@class='v-text-field__slot']/input") send keys(NewTeacherAutotest123511949)

$("By.xpath: //div[@class='v-list mb-2 v-sheet theme--light v-list--subheader v-list--three-line']//button[@class='v-btn v-btn--is-elevated v-btn--has-bg theme--light v-size--default']
") should be(visible)

$("By.xpath: //div[@class='v-list mb-2 v-sheet theme--light v-list--subheader v-list--three-line']//button[@class='v-btn v-btn--is-elevated v-btn--has-bg theme--light v-size--default']
") click()
$("By.xpath: //span[@class='v-chip v-chip--clickable v-chip--label theme--light v-size--default green']") should be(visible)
$("By.xpath: //div[@class='primary-button btn-class-action add-students btn-flex btn-flex']") should be(visible)
$("By.xpath: //div[@class='vld-overlay is-active is-full-page']") should have(css value display=none)
$("By.xpath: //div[@class='activity-container']/section/*[self::section or self::div].findBy(text "Recurring Weekly Activity for New Class")") should be(visible)
